column7: Writes a /mcp admission refusal before the route answers it, and turns it into the log's 503 when a fail-closed log cannot take the record.
The stdio twin of the admission writer: records the refusal through the meta layer's log, and answers -32005 when a fail-closed log refuses it.

The one stdio settle-and-answer for signing and malformed-retry refusals: writes the record through the meta layer's log, and answers the log's unavailability instead when the refusal follows the log and a fail-closed log refused it.
Records a stdio call with malformed retry fields as /mcp does, before answering -32602.
Builds the malformed-retry record (invalid -32602, kind syntax, no target); a mistake would record the refusal under the wrong kind or outcome.
Builds an admission refusal's record: outcome from the error, the target as requested, the noted kind else unrecorded, and the follow-the-log policy.
